title: lunch-plans
text:
lunch-plans

Tommy Reed: Random after-work idea: Rooftop ‘Gong Show’ open-mic + pizza & pints next Thursday? low pressure — 2-min acts, prizes, and pizza slices. 🍕🔔
Sasha Bloom: love the name. 2-min acts sounds perfect. what time were you thinking?
Tommy Reed: start 7pm, doors 6:45. pizza at 7:15. acts 7:30-9:00.
Ravi Shah: I can DJ a short goofy interlude. also can bring a roll of paper plates.
June Park: can do 7pm. I’ll bring a vegan pizza (labelled). please label allergens!
Lena Ortiz: fun. count me in if we cap at like 30 so it stays cozy.
Tommy Reed: cap 30 — rooftop has space. if more we’ll rotate sets or move indoors.
Marco Silva: I’ll handle ordering 3 pies (cheese, pepperoni, vegan) and some non-alcoholic sparkling. people pay me back via venmo.
Gia Tran: I’m down. can we have a quick sign-up for acts so it doesn’t turn into a chaos free-for-all?
Tommy Reed: yes — simple signup in this thread: comment with ACT: short title.
Sasha Bloom: ACT: “Two-Minute Cover of an 80s Jingle” 😂
Ravi Shah: ACT: “Impromptu Beatbox + Sock Puppet”
June Park: ACT: maybe a tiny spoken-word piece, will sign up proper later.
OpsBot: Event created: Rooftop Gong Show + Pizza & Pints — Thursday 19:00. Reminder 1h before.
Lena Ortiz: logistics Q: will there be chairs? rooftop benches are limited.
Tommy Reed: please bring folding chairs if you have them; I’ll stash a few bean bags and a blanket.
Marco Silva: payment logistics: $6 per person for pizza portion (est). I’ll post a paypal/venmo request after count.
Gia Tran: accessibility note: please keep one quieter seating area away from speakers for anyone sensitive to noise.
Sasha Bloom: I’ll bring a little mic + speaker. can someone bring an extra extension cord?
Ravi Shah: extension cord + gaffer tape on my end.
June Park: allergen reminder — I’ll label the vegan pizza as vegan + dairy-free. anyone allergic to sesame/peanuts?
Lena Ortiz: peanut allergy here. will avoid.
Tommy Reed: great—we’ll put a clear food table with labels.
Marco Silva: RSVP with emoji: 👍 = in, 🤷 = maybe, ❌ = out.
Sasha Bloom: 👍
Ravi Shah: 👍
June Park: 👍
Lena Ortiz: 👍
Marco Silva: 👍
Gia Tran: 👍
Tommy Reed: current RSVP: 7 — still under cap. will bump the thread if we hit 25+ and need signups closed.
Gia Tran: Prize idea: the audience votes for fave act, winner gets a silly trophy + a free pizza slice coupon. low-stakes.
Sasha Bloom: sold. I’ll make a tiny cardboard trophy.
Tommy Reed: last note: rooftop permit is cleared with Ops. if anyone wants to bring extra snacks or hot sauce, drop it in the thread. see you Thursday! 🎤🍕
